fns.desc: hostapd_init(): in the per-BSS allocation loop, if hostapd_alloc_bss_data() fails partway through (i>0), goto fail only frees hapd_iface->bss (the array) and hapd_iface itself, never the already-allocated hapd_iface->bss[0..i-1] structures from earlier iterations -- leaked on this (rare, OOM-only) error path. The sibling function hostapd_data_alloc() (line 3809) walks back and frees prior elements on the same failure shape, showing the codebase knows the correct pattern here.
